Yes for devnet 4 <@466006586477772831> made a docker-compose setup for geth + lighthouse on devnet 3 if people are interested https://github.com/jimmygchen/devnet-v3 do we have any hive tests for 4844? Question on `BeaconBlocksByRoot` and `BeaconBlockAndBlobsSidecarByRoot` RPCs. If `BeaconBlocksByRoot` is called with a post-`EIP4844_FORK_EPOCH` root, what should the RPC return ? And likewise if `BeaconBlockAndBlobsSidecarByRoot` is called with a pre-`EIP4844_FORK_EPOCH` root? > BeaconBlocksByRoot is called with a post-EIP4844_FORK_EPOCH root My assumption has been that this should just return the beacon block > BeaconBlockAndBlobsSidecarByRoot is called with a pre-EIP4844_FORK_EPOCH root This one I think is sepc'd out as a `Resource Unavailable`, right? > My assumption has been that this should just return the beacon block If we go with that, I think this phrasing should be removed/clarified `After EIP4844_FORK_EPOCH, BeaconBlocksByRootV2 is replaced by BeaconBlockAndBlobsSidecarByRootV1` > This one I think is sepc'd out as a Resource Unavailable, right? Oh right! I misread that. Ok so this one is clear in the spec. So with that clarified, it seems a little inconsistent with phase0/BeaconBlockByRange, where you return Resource Unavailable if you are unable to answer requests _within_ MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOCK_REQUESTS, and you get descored/disconnected as a results. But that's a separate issue. not yet, but soon-ish. Will have time end this week to update the libs/tools in Hive for 4844 support

excerpts.author: realbigsean
excerpts.content:
> BeaconBlocksByRoot is called with a post-EIP4844_FORK_EPOCH root

My assumption has been that this should just return the beacon block

> BeaconBlockAndBlobsSidecarByRoot is called with a pre-EIP4844_FORK_EPOCH  root

This one I think is sepc'd out as a `Resource Unavailable`, right?

excerpts.author: henridf
excerpts.content:
> My assumption has been that this should just return the beacon block

If we go with that, I think this phrasing should be removed/clarified
`After EIP4844_FORK_EPOCH, BeaconBlocksByRootV2 is replaced by BeaconBlockAndBlobsSidecarByRootV1`

excerpts.author: henridf
excerpts.content:
> This one I think is sepc'd out as a Resource Unavailable, right?

Oh right! I misread that. Ok so this one is clear in the spec. So with that clarified, it seems a little inconsistent with phase0/BeaconBlockByRange, where you return Resource Unavailable if you are unable to answer requests _within_  MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOCK_REQUESTS, and you get descored/disconnected as a results. But that's a separate issue.
